Meet the creator

“I help other people on their need. I care about the hopeless, the helpless, and those that stand in need. In the middle of the night I come to them and give them the advice.”

Ting Lott, RN built the AI Command Center the same way he has always worked: calmly, clearly, and with the person in front of him in mind. His approach to AI is the one on this page — let the tool assist, and keep the human in charge.

Ting brings 17 years of nursing in psychiatric and crisis care — serving as a Crisis and Navigation RN — and, before nursing, 5 years as an elementary school teacher. That mix of crisis calm and a teacher's patience is what makes this course beginner-friendly: every step is explained the way he would explain it to someone sitting across from him.
